epithet.en: Vienna's ruler, who hands the city to Angelo and watches in disguise

1.modern-en: The Duke confers his authority on Angelo, names Escalus as his secondary, and prepares to leave Vienna for what he says are private affairs.

3.modern-en: The Duke confides to Friar Thomas that he means to spy on Angelo from disguise to see how power changes him, and borrows a friar's habit.

7.modern-en: The Duke, disguised as a friar, visits the pregnant Juliet in the prison and elicits her confession of her love and her shame.

9.modern-en: The Duke listens to Isabella's report of Angelo's bargain, proposes the bed-trick with Mariana, and reassures Claudio in his cell.

10.modern-en: The Duke is slandered to his own friar-face by Lucio in the street and resolves to remember the offence.

12.modern-en: The Duke, still in disguise, intercepts the order for Claudio's head and substitutes the head of the dead pirate Ragozine.

13.modern-en: The Duke deals with Pompey and the unmanageable Barnardine in the prison and arranges the alternative head.

15.modern-en: The Duke gives Friar Peter his final instructions for the public unmasking at the city gate.

16.modern-en: The Duke, in disguise, oversees Isabella and Mariana taking their stations at the city gate for the formal appeal.

17.modern-en: The Duke arrives in his own person, hears the women's complaints, exposes Angelo, restores Claudio, and proposes marriage twice to Isabella.

1.modern-en: Angelo is named deputy of Vienna and given the Duke's commission with the explicit power to apply the laws as he sees fit.

5.modern-en: Angelo presides with Escalus over the comic case of Pompey and Froth and orders Claudio's execution to proceed.

6.modern-en: Angelo receives Isabella for the first time, is moved by her, and is shaken by what he feels.

8.modern-en: Angelo, in his second meeting with Isabella, makes the explicit bargain: Claudio's life for her virginity.

14.modern-en: Angelo, after the supposed assignation, sends a fresh order for Claudio's execution and broods on what he has done.

17.modern-en: Angelo is exposed before the city gate, confesses his crimes, is sentenced to death, married to Mariana, and finally pardoned.

epithet.en: Claudio's sister, a novice at the convent of St Clare

4.modern-en: Isabella is at the convent door asking Sister Francisca for the strictest order's rules when Lucio arrives with news of Claudio's arrest.

6.modern-en: Isabella goes to Angelo and pleads for Claudio's life with extraordinary force, persuading him almost despite herself.

8.modern-en: Isabella returns to Angelo, hears his bargain, and refuses with 'More than our brother is our chastity.'

9.modern-en: Isabella tells Claudio in his cell what Angelo has asked and rejects his plea that she yield; the Duke, overhearing, proposes the bed-trick.

11.modern-en: Isabella, at the grange of St Luke's, persuades Mariana to take her place in Angelo's bed.

16.modern-en: Isabella waits with Mariana at the city gate to make their formal appeal to the returning Duke.

17.modern-en: Isabella accuses Angelo before the city, then kneels with Mariana to beg his life, and stands silently as the Duke proposes marriage.

epithet.en: Isabella's brother, condemned for premarital sex

2.modern-en: Claudio is led under arrest through the streets of Vienna by the Provost and explains to Lucio that he is condemned under the old fornication law for having got Juliet with child.

7.modern-en: Claudio is visited in the prison by the disguised Duke and prepared by him for death.

9.modern-en: Claudio hears from Isabella the terms Angelo has set, delivers the great speech 'Ay, but to die, and go we know not where,' and asks her to comply.

17.modern-en: Claudio is brought out at the city gate, restored alive to his sister and his Juliet, and pardoned by the Duke.

epithet.en: A loud, scurrilous gentleman of Vienna

2.modern-en: Lucio meets Claudio on his way to prison, hears his case, and agrees to fetch Isabella from the convent.

4.modern-en: Lucio arrives at the convent and persuades Isabella to leave the cloister to plead for Claudio.

10.modern-en: Lucio meets the disguised Duke in the street and slanders the Duke himself at length to his unrecognised face.

12.modern-en: Lucio is at the prison spreading the latest of his own inventions about the Duke.

17.modern-en: Lucio is unmasked at the city gate and sentenced by the Duke to marry the prostitute he has dishonoured.

epithet.en: Angelo's spurned fiancée at the grange of St Luke's

11.modern-en: Mariana, at the moated grange, listens to a boy sing a melancholy song and is brought into the Duke's plan to substitute for Isabella.

16.modern-en: Mariana waits with Isabella at the city gate, veiled, for her cue in the public scene.

17.modern-en: Mariana unveils before the city to claim Angelo as her husband, kneels to beg his life, and is granted him.

epithet.en: An ancient Viennese lord, Angelo's secondary

1.modern-en: Escalus is named by the Duke as Angelo's second in council and is given his own commission for what he can carry alone.

5.modern-en: Escalus presides with Angelo over the comic case of Pompey, Froth, and Elbow.

15.modern-en: Escalus is given quiet instructions by the disguised Duke as the unmasking is prepared.

17.modern-en: Escalus is at the city gate during the public scene and is named by the returning Duke as the just officer who held the city together.

5.modern-en: The Provost asks Angelo, painfully, whether Claudio's sentence is really to be carried out.

7.modern-en: The Provost brings the disguised Duke to the pregnant Juliet's cell.

9.modern-en: The Provost stands by during Claudio's interview with Isabella and respects the friar's instructions.

12.modern-en: The Provost receives Angelo's renewed order for Claudio's head and is persuaded by the disguised Duke to delay it.

13.modern-en: The Provost listens as the Duke arranges for the pirate Ragozine's head to be sent in Claudio's place.

17.modern-en: The Provost is praised by the Duke at the city gate for his service and brings the prisoners forward.

epithet.en: Servant in Mistress Overdone's brothel, later assistant executioner

2.modern-en: Pompey brings Mistress Overdone the news that all the brothels of the suburbs are to be plucked down by Angelo's new law.

5.modern-en: Pompey is brought before Angelo and Escalus by the constable Elbow on charges of bawdry, and Escalus dismisses the case with a warning.

10.modern-en: Pompey is arrested again on the street by Elbow and is taken off to the prison.

13.modern-en: Pompey is enlisted in the prison as Abhorson's assistant executioner and starts naming all the customers he has known there.

epithet.en: The friar enlisted in the Duke's public scheme

3.modern-en: Friar Thomas hears the Duke's plan in the monastery and provides the habit and the cover for his disguise.

15.modern-en: Friar Peter is given his cues for the public scene at the city gate.

17.modern-en: Friar Peter brings forward Mariana at the city gate and witnesses the contract.
